description: This file defines the GithubIdentityProviderException class, which extends IdentityProviderException, and provides methods to create exceptions based on HTTP responses encountered during OAuth2 authentication flows with GitHub.

classes.name: GithubIdentityProviderException
classes.description: A custom exception class for GitHub OAuth2 identity provider errors, providing static methods to generate exceptions based on HTTP responses.

methods.name: clientException
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from an HTTP response and response data, representing client-side errors during OAuth2 processes.

methods.name: oauthException
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from an HTTP response and response data, representing OAuth-related errors.

methods.name: fromResponse
methods.description: Constructs an exception based on an HTTP response, extracting message and status code details.
